items.title: Weston family closes in on £7bn Boots takeover
items.summary: The billionaire Weston family behind Primark is reportedly closing in on a £7bn deal to acquire Boots from current owner Sycamore Partners. The proposed deal would value Boots at around £6.7bn, including debt and comes after months of negotiations between the Boots’ owners and…

items.title: Danone to invest in “benchmark” Volvic site
items.summary: Danone is investing over €50m ($56.8m) in its Volvic bottling facility in France, principally to improve the environmental credentials of the site.

items.title: Mondelēz International recruits a top European executive from Danone
items.summary: Mondelēz International, the company behind brands such as Oreo, Côte d'Or, LU, and Milka, has appointed Richard Trechman as Senior Vice President of its operations in Northwestern Europe. He is joining the company from Danone.

items.title: Philipp Stiehler Steps Up As CEO Of Penny Hungary
items.summary: Penny Hungary has announced a change at the helm, with Philipp Stiehler taking over as chief executive officer on 1 October 2026.

items.title: Polish off-price retailer HalfPrice expands to Belgium
items.summary: HalfPrice, a Polish outlet retailer with more than 220 stores in 15 European countries, is coming to Belgium: in November, the chain will open five stores in Shopping Cora malls, followed by a sixth in 2027.

items.title: Omoda acquires Belgium’s oldest shoe store
items.summary: Omoda is taking over the nearly 300-year-old Mertens Schoenen and the adjacent Van Bommel store in the heart of Leuven. The historic buildings will reopen next year after a renovation as Omoda’s second brick-and-mortar boutique in Belgium, following the one in Antwerp.

items.title: Another record revenue for Søstrene Grene
items.summary: With revenue growth of more than 16% in the past fiscal year, Søstrene Grene has once again broken a record. The Danish home goods retailer opened 72 stores and entered three new markets in Europe.

items.title: General Mills promotes COO McNabb to chief executive
items.summary: General Mills COO Dana McNabb will move to the CEO role at the US food giant at the start of the year to replace Jeff Harmening. The post General Mills promotes COO McNabb to chief executive appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: French shoe chain André is closing its doors for good after 130 years
items.summary: After 130 years, the well-known French shoe store chain André is disappearing from the scene, following a long series of restructurings and takeovers. Of a network that once numbered 500 stores, only a handful remained recently.

items.title: Cheerios maker General Mills names company veteran as CEO
items.summary: Dana McNabb, who has been with the food maker since 1999, will take over from Jeff Harmening in January.

items.title: Danone appeals move to block Harrogate Spring Water expansion plans
items.summary: Danone is appealing a decision to stop a move to expand its Harrogate Spring Water site in northern England.

items.title: Reaching the 3,000-store mark is by no means the end for Maxi Zoo owner Fressnapf
